subject: executor: remove parallel sort system variable (#51769)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff vs first parent with focus on `pkg/executor/sortexec` and `pkg/sessionctx/variable`. The change cleanly removes the `enable_parallel_sort` sysvar/session flag and forces `SortExec` to run the existing unparallel code path; parallel-path unit tests were adjusted to explicitly initialize parallel mode. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL/session semantics, concurrency/cleanup, or sysvar loading behavior (unknown rows in `mysql.global_variables` are ignored by the sysvar cache rebuild logic).
